NONE: C2 specialized environment very dry and without enough rain for plants
乾燥的，乾旱的
› formal unsuccessful
不成功的；無結果的
› formal not interesting and showing no imagination
枯燥的；無創見的，無新意的

example: The desert is so arid that nothing can grow there.
沙漠中極其乾旱，寸草不生。
After several arid years, the company has started to become successful.
經過了幾個不景氣的年頭後，公司已經開始走向成功發展之路。
I found his writing extremely arid.
我覺得他寫的東西毫無新意。

正確地

example: Did I hear/understand you aright?
